name: SWAG
definition: A method that extends 3DGS by conditioning Gaussians on learned appearance embeddings and training unsupervised transient Gaussians to ignore occluders.
summary: SWAG extends 3D Gaussian Splatting by training unsupervised transient Gaussians to ignore occluders, distinguishing itself by explicitly modeling transient elements as separate entities rather than relying on depth regularization.
